description: Complete the record: pass the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_swap_record UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/net/swap-records); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the wallet that sent the swap. A record moves no token and holds none, and it reads unverified. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_net_swap_record, unchanged.
